kind: independent read-only plan/scope review, no implementation signing
user_value: Separate ordinary application-use screen from engineering approval controls: pick numeric column, enqueue existing frozen CSV instance, read current result/history, reopen in fresh session.
existing_backend_basis: app_jobs.enqueue locks owner project, verifies current instance and exact release/revision, binds input/request key before queue
normal worker validates frozen manifest/input/current authorization and commits own result version
lifecycle.create_instance inherits existing draft runtime_id; no new Grant necessary
normal CSV branch has zero model requests; do not describe Mock provider attempts as necessary CSV execution
required_bounds: Existing frozen release binds one authorized resource and manifest/action; parameterization is numeric column of that resource, not replacing resource or arbitrary new CSV upload
Use existing authorized instance/release GET, current ownership and source fingerprint/revision; do not copy another project's app-column DOM options into new instance
Do not auto-approve/create release, grant, publish, enable LIVE or infer semantic acceptance
Instance selection and result GET must guard current identity/project/session/selection generation on success and failure
Freeze request key/input/release revision for uncertain acceptance, recover same intent; accepted GET failure is read-only recovery
Current result must match selected instance and known Run/result_version; history shown as history with input/status/version/time rather than substituting old success for pending/failed current run
New session finds persisted instance/history without private browser cache; switched/revoked resource and stale release require explicit bounded failure
Rendered modes remain internal zero-model execution, source is frozen synthetic/authorized CSV, technical success does not label full goal/F1/P-B signing
No expansion of existing CI destination/slots/security/workflow limits
minimal_verification: Same frozen CSV with two supported numeric columns produces own normal async Run/result versions, real authorized receipts; zero new Grants/principals/model attempts
Two instances/projects/identities remain separate through fresh page, A-B-A and late success/failure; no stale current result or old controls
Lost accepted reply doubleclick/samekey, accepted GET failure, current input validation failure, revoked read/action and changed source/release
Non-numeric/missing column, empty/bounded UI options, text/XSS/time/version labels and narrow layout
Merged source exact hash must get relevant local regression and native Windows acceptance; current bd CI only signs bd source
remaining_open: Plan only: implementation and native checks NOT_RUN
